metadata.name: 03 Repeat Apply
metadata.notes: Recording after applying filters not setting updates

operator_context: Operator confirmed that Apply was clicked only once, after reopening the Fantech Windows app. Despite the recording name Repeat Apply, this is a second independent startup-plus-single-Apply run.
method: Read all original PCAPNG blocks with validated block trailers. Compare control-submit endpoint-zero OUT records with URB length 8 and raw setup-slot bytes starting 07 18. capinfos independently confirms file size, packet count, and duration. No hardware commands replayed.

interpretations.finding: Two feature-request bursts were recorded; each has 867 report-07/command-18 candidate data-stage records.
The first candidate report sequence exactly matches 01 startup; the second exactly matches the later sequence in 02.
One Apply click was performed. Two bursts therefore fit startup followed by one Apply, and provide no evidence about a second same-session Apply click.

limitations: Captured control phases are separate VirtualBox records; packet count is not a Windows API call count.
Many records have captured lengths smaller than original lengths. The setup-slot comparison is not a reconstructed full-payload trace.
The differing byte has no established UI-setting or persistent-memory meaning.
UI attribution uses guided actions and matching sequences; no exact UI event timestamp was recorded.
Original source capture and metadata remain unchanged.

analysis_window.scope_note: Historical totals are full-capture counts. Setting-change comparisons use this time window and separate startup matching.

publication_note: Local VM names and host-assigned USB UUIDs are redacted; personal absolute paths are normalized. Capture hashes, packet evidence and findings are retained. Raw captures remain private.
